title: Bulk enrolment from the customer's Assets tab
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Schedule "Highway Tractor PM" exists (standard seeding steps, by a user with Settings Service).
  3. A customer with several assets, e.g. "Greenhills Operations EVR LTD Sparwood" (22 assets, 4 of them matching "Truck": Auto Truck, 2005 Bobcat Trailer, 2012 Chevrolet 3500, Toyota 4 Runner).
  4. The 2005 Bobcat is already enrolled on "Highway Tractor PM" (its Maintenance tab > Enroll in Schedule). Two of the other "Truck" assets have a past completion of a service named like one on the schedule (Mark complete > Completed elsewhere on an earlier schedule).
custom_steps:
1. Open the customer's Assets tab and find Enroll in Schedule; click it and pick "Highway Tractor PM".
  2. Read the Assets section: checkboxes, Select all, the search; type "Truck" in the search.
  3. Read the Bobcat's row; tick the other three and read the action button.
  4. Change the search to "Chevrolet", then clear it; check the three ticks.
  5. Read what the modal says about last service dates and certificates, then click the action button.
  6. Reopen Enroll in Schedule with the same schedule and search "Truck".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Enroll in Schedule sits beside New Asset and opens the enrolment modal with an Assets section: every asset of the customer with a checkbox, Select all, and a search.
  • The search matches type, make, unit and VIN: "Truck" leaves the 4 matching assets.
  • The Bobcat is greyed, cannot be ticked and reads "Already on this schedule"; with three ticked the button reads "Enroll 3 assets".
  • The three ticks survive the search change.
  • No last service dates and no certificates are asked for; the modal says "2 of 3 have a last service on record; the rest count from today."
  • After enrolling, the three assets read "Already on this schedule" as well.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S7 (Several assets at once; S7-R24 to S7-R26, S7-N4, S7-N7); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 6 Phase P2, frontend table (EnrolmentAssetsSection); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboards X4a to X4d; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R24: “The customer's Assets tab has Enroll in Schedule beside New Asset. It opens the enrolment modal with an Assets section: every asset of that customer with a checkbox and Select all, and a search matching type, make, unit and VIN”
  • Design board, artboard X4b: “Matches type, make, unit and VIN.”
  • S7-R25: “In the Assets section an asset already on the chosen schedule is greyed, cannot be ticked, and reads Already on this schedule. The action reads Enroll N assets”
  • Plan 1 §6 P2 EnrolmentAssetsSection: “Selections survive a search change”
  • S7-R26: “Bulk enrolment asks for no last service dates and no certificates. Each asset takes its dates from its own history, per S7-R4, and the modal says how many have one, for example 8 of 12 have a last service on record; the rest count from today”
  • S7-N7: “Bulk enrolment works for one customer at a time, from that customer's Assets tab. There is no enrolment across customers”
  • S7-N4: “There is no bulk path from the schedule side”
